hypothesis: Fixed M5 training OOF shows heterogeneous evidence within same-patient/same-diagnosis images. A fit-only bag auxiliary objective may share evidence across such images without requiring a bag at inference. Bag/image accuracy units differ; this is not evidence of label error or improvement.
architecture: Original M5 plus a training-only zero-initialized linear 256-to-1 quality scorer reading pre-Dropout hidden features. Bag image probabilities and diagnosis probabilities use mean/within-bag softmax pooling. Export removes quality scorer and loads strictly into original M5 single-image Model.
bags: Construct only within current fit patients using (patient_group,disease,label); never merge discordant diagnoses/classes. Bag weights balance coarse class and patient, dividing multiple same-patient/coarse-class diagnoses. All images appear once per epoch; random group order, no split bag, target256images/batch. Save every epoch group order and coverage hashes.
training: Original M5 image losses, patient/class image weights, hyperparameters, original fit/stop/outer splits, image-based early stopping. Add lambda times bag coarse label-smoothed NLL +0.8diagnosisNLL, balanced by bag patient/class weights. Common initialization/RNG preserved. All four arms have identical complete-bag sampling, including zero auxiliary control; no additional contrastive loss at bag level.
evaluation: Four fixed configurations each3formal seeds+3outer folds x3seeds. Single-image validation and patient-CV determine selection; group scores descriptive only.
selection: Original patient-CV Macro-F1 must exceed0.8090823139275858 and original validation Macro-F1 must be at least0.8893107959516184. Freeze qualifier before fresh fixed patient confirmation against M5 and fixed Gaussian. No automatic external evaluation.
verification: Independent NumPy pooling and loss, invariance, numerical derivatives, coverage and weights, initialization and RNG, zero auxiliary identity, full gradients and strict export checked. All48actual heads will undergo CPU stop/outer restoration, export identity, fit-stat/split/disease/bag reconstruction and every epoch coverage audit.
external_test_policy: Only development fit/stop/outer rows used; all explicit inference indices below2091. No external metrics read or evaluated for this study.
